item.quote: Great family fun and easy navigating. Parking was a breeze. Highly recommend any event at Moda.
item.name: Quintin

item.quote: Security was excellent- my daughter uses a medical device and can’t go through scanner. It’s been an issue at other venues, but they were excellent with her. Thank you!
item.name: Devin

item.quote: I saw Journey here about 45 years ago and it is still just as good now as it was then. The sound is excellent and the venue is easy to navigate.
item.name: Paul

item.quote: Attending the Journey concert was such a great experience and brought back so many memories!
item.name: Teresa
